title: Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning for Image-Based Continuous Control with Gaussian and Beta Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.38407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: Behavior cloning can accumulate errors when a learned controller visits states outside the demonstrated distribution. This study evaluates whether Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control. Methods: A controlled CarRacing study combines Gaussian and Beta learner policies, demonstrations from either a clipped Gaussian expert or an intrinsically bounded Beta expert, one or 20 trajectories, deterministic and stochastic evaluation, and three retained stages: behavior cloning, the highest 10-episode training-score checkpoint, and the final DRIL checkpoint. The disagreement ensemble contains five Gaussian policies in every variant. Each retained policy is evaluated over 100 procedurally generated episodes. translated_title: 采用高斯与Beta策略、面向图像式连续控制的分歧正则化模仿学习
translated_abstract: 目的：当学习到的控制器访问示范分布之外的状态时，行为克隆可能会累积误差。本研究评估了分歧正则化模仿学习（DRIL）——该方法将克隆策略之间的分歧转化为强化学习奖励——能否改进基于图像的连续控制。方法：一项受控的CarRacing实验研究综合了以下要素：高斯与Beta学习器策略、来自截断高斯专家或内在有界Beta专家的示范、1条或20条轨迹、确定性与随机性两种评估方式，以及三个保留阶段：行为克隆、10回合训练得分最高的检查点，以及最终的DRIL检查点。在所有变体中，分歧集成均包含五个高斯策略。每个保留策略均在100个程序化生成的回合上进行评估。结果：经得分选择的DRIL在少示范设置中产生了最大的增益，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究的核心贡献是验证了分歧正则化模仿学习（DRIL）——通过将克隆策略之间的分歧转化为强化学习奖励——能够改进基于图像的连续控制，并且其收益在仅有少量示范轨迹的稀疏数据设置下最为显著。
en_tdlr: Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control, yielding its largest gains in few-demonstration settings.
